content: Listen to the wind; it talks. Listen to the silence; it speaks. Listen to your heart; it knows.
author: Native American Proverbs
sourceWork: Native American Oral Lore & Mountain Wisdom
explanation: Human beings have surrounded themselves with artificial buzzers, digital notifications, and endless chatter, and then wonder why they feel spiritually bankrupt and confused. When you quiet your frantic internal voice and listen with deep reverence, creation itself speaks.
practicalInsight: Go outside, close your eyes, and listen to the wind moving through the leaves for three minutes without checking your phone.
reflectionPrompt: What wisdom is trying to reach you that you have been drowning out with digital noise?
